START

INPUT NODE

Encounter bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(145px, 0px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
CHECK ERROR MESSAGES

PROCESSING NODE

Read error messages, stack traces, line numbers, file paths
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(145px, 170px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
REPRODUCE CONSISTENTLY

PROCESSING NODE

Identify exact steps to trigger the issue, ensure it happens every time
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(145px, 340px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
CHECK RECENT CHANGES

PROCESSING NODE

Review git diff, recent commits, new dependencies, config changes
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(145px, 510px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
GATHER EVIDENCE (MULTI-COMPONENT)

PROCESSING NODE

Add diagnostic instrumentation at each component boundary, log data flow, verify environment propagation
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(10px, 680px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
TRACE DATA FLOW

PROCESSING NODE

Use root-cause-tracing.md to trace bad value back to source
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(280px, 680px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
FIND WORKING EXAMPLES

PROCESSING NODE

Locate similar working code in same codebase
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(145px, 850px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
COMPARE AGAINST REFERENCES

PROCESSING NODE

Read reference implementation completely, understand pattern fully
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 1020px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
IDENTIFY DIFFERENCES

PROCESSING NODE

List differences between working and broken, however small
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 1190px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
UNDERSTAND DEPENDENCIES

PROCESSING NODE

Check required components, settings, config, environment, assumptions
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 1360px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
FORM SINGLE HYPOTHESIS

DECISION NODE

State clearly: 'I think X is the root cause because Y'
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 1530px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
TEST MINIMALLY

PROCESSING NODE

Make smallest possible change to test hypothesis, one variable at a time
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(0px, 1700px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
VERIFY BEFORE CONTINUING

DECISION NODE

Did it work? Yes → implement fix, No → form new hypothesis
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 1870px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
CREATE FAILING TEST CASE

PROCESSING NODE

Simplest possible reproduction, automated test if possible
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 2040px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
IMPLEMENT SINGLE FIX

PROCESSING NODE

Address root cause identified, ONE change at a time
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 2210px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
VERIFY FIX

DECISION NODE

Test passes now? No other tests broken? Issue actually resolved?
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(72.5px, 2380px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
QUESTION ARCHITECTURE

DECISION NODE

If 3+ fixes failed, STOP and question fundamentals, discuss with human partner
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(217.5px, 2550px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;

nodes.text:
END

OUTPUT NODE

Bug resolved, tests pass
nodes.style: z-index: 0; transform: translate(145px, 2720px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible;
